send_path.writer: single host console writer (xkwin); no concurrent sender
send_path.pre_send: Read-Available quiet 80 ms / max 400 ms to drain prompt and echo
send_path.target: one logical line (commands may contain quoted semicolons)
send_path.why: the old 25 ms target→marker gap produced a real corrupted marker line ('eecho') in B3; rc is saved before the echo so the target is never re-run to recover a status

limits: bytes are logical UTF-8 bytes handed to the TCP console, not a packet capture
terminal echo/cursor-query bytes are preserved in console.log but not classified separately

failure_rule.frame_missing_or_corrupt: do not rerun the target command; report unknown unless the saved /tmp/xk-rc-<nonce> can be read and associated
failure_rule.current_recovery: rc file is written but automatic recovery is not implemented; a failed frame remains a delivery failure

acceptance.note: delivery validation only; not a 20-start browser reliability test
